remarks: Welcome to this hidden gem & Fantastic rental opportunity. Conveniently located on a quiet cul-de-sac. in the vibrant Saugatuck water-side community of Westport CT. Three spacious, updated, ample sized bedrooms w/ 2 full baths make up this ranch style home. Large, sun-drenched eat-in kitchen/dining rm w/plenty of space for entertaining.Huge Living room w/slate fireplace & stunning oak floors.Additional multi-use lower-level w/separate entrance, sep. zoned heat, full bath(stand-up shower),large laundry rm, storage area & interior garage access. Steps to Saugatuck Elementary school, water, town, train & Gilberties! Walk-up unfinished attic for additional storage. Tenant to use owners utilities & cleaner. Pls.email questions & offers to list agent
